explication: TotalSegmentator is a CT/MR anatomical segmentation and quantitative reporting toolkit. The principal workflow accepts NIfTI or DICOM input, converts and preprocesses it, selects a configured task, runs nnUNet models, postprocesses masks, and writes segmentation outputs and optional statistics. Separate report pipelines derive aorta, pulmonary, and spine measurements. The MCP server exposes task discovery and command execution. Core orchestration and several report internals were inferred from documented paths and sampled excerpts; unsampled wiring is shown conservatively.
